verses.1: And Zofar said, “May my prayers be heard.”
verses.2: Many things will not be answered. And if someone speaks in a loud voice, they will still not be heard.
verses.3: In the days to come, they will be destroyed and gone forever. There will be no more of them.
verses.4: And Zakh said, “Take it. I was in your eyes.”
verses.5: But who will give him the word, and open his mouth along with you?
verses.6: And I will reveal to you the mysteries of wisdom. They are like two doors that lead to the depths of knowledge. And know that there is a God who will guide you along that path.
verses.7: The study of God will be complete only when all of His secrets are revealed.
verses.8: What will happen to the heights of heaven? What will happen to those who are proud and arrogant?
verses.9: It extends from the land of Midian, and it is vast as the sea.
verses.10: If they are moved and transferred, and if they are gathered together, then who will put them back in their proper place?
verses.11: For he knew the ways of deception and saw that it was futile to try to avoid them.
verses.12: And a proud man will be despised, and a wicked person will be destroyed.
verses.13: If you prepare your heart and set it before Him as you should.
verses.14: If you have the power to drive them away, then don’t let them stay in your tent.
verses.15: For then, your faces will be raised from the ground, and you will be able to see clearly. You will not be afraid anymore.
verses.16: For when you work hard, you will forget. Just like rivers that flow on and on, you will also forget.
verses.17: And from the ruins, a rat will rise up. It will fly away in the morning.
verses.18: And you are certain that there will be a time when you will cry out in despair and lie down in sorrow.
verses.19: And you have been troubled, and there is no one to relieve you; your faces are covered with many wounds.
verses.20: And the eyes of the wicked will be blotted out; their pride will be destroyed from them, and their arrogance will be eradicated.
